entries.title: The archive learns to rabbit-hole
entries.summary: Every entry on the shelves now carries its marks, and each cabinet gains a sieve: choose any marks and only the records that bear them remain. Within the records, the names of other entries stand bold and lead onward — to records already written, and, bold in bronze, to the ones still unwritten.

entries.title: The Phookas take the record
entries.summary: The second full record is written: a shapeshifting fey of chaos and crossroads, dangerous the way a prank can be dangerous. Its pages link to the Grimlings, and the Grimlings back to it, so the archive begins to weave itself into rabbit-holes. The Grimlings' own record is corrected in passing: their folklore strands are given their true ages, and the miners pay their Knockers in bread, not iron.

entries.title: The first record is written: Grimlings
entries.summary: Tier three of the Bestiary opens. The Grimlings record arrives in full — nature, habits, weaknesses, variants — and every beast now carries the new tag taxonomy, woven into search for ready reference.

entries.title: The Bestiary opens its cabinets
entries.summary: Three cabinets of the world's hungry things, each leading to its own hall of records: the folklore that remained understood, the horrors that fester in the wounds, and the cursed. Full records for each creature will follow. Spirits and true elementals keep their own record among the Peoples.

entries.title: The Peoples index finds its voice
entries.summary: Every people of the hub now greets you in its own words instead of the World's. The Cursed & Changed are introduced as a category of beings and handed to the Bestiary for their kinds and weaknesses.

entries.title: The wounded almanac opens
entries.summary: Seven phases, twenty-eight Naming Days, and the unbound days between them — the Calendar now keeps the world's pulse.

entries.title: The archive gains a chronicle
entries.summary: The site now records its own growth. Every addition, revision, and repair will be entered here, newest first.

entries.title: The Peoples index opened
entries.summary: Ten peoples across five categories, each with its own page.

entries.title: History of the Realms raised
entries.summary: The timeline spine now stands: the Great Wounding, the Long Fade, and the eras every story is measured against.

entries.title: Search woven into the navbar
entries.summary: Fuzzy search across every page, forgiving of missing umlauts and half-remembered names.

entries.title: The Nature of Magic sealed
entries.summary: Three sources, three practices, and the four rules that no weaver has ever broken twice.

entries.title: The mist learned to drift
entries.summary: The background now parallaxes gently as you walk, and no longer snaps when the browser's own chrome shifts.

entries.title: Foundation laid
entries.summary: The first page of the Duskward Realms opens its doors.
